title: Translation Of A Letter No. 1890 From The Public Safety

page_data.en:
MUNICIPAL
D. REGISTRY
D. 696.
31.10.29.

October 31, 29.

Sir,

The Chinese Lai Yu Medicine Co.

With reference to your letter No. 1890
regarding the sale of "Safety Liquid Medicine
for Cure of Opium Addiction" I have to inform
you that the sale and advertisement of this
medicine has been suspended pending a
settlement of the matter with the Ministry of
Labour and Commerce.

Yours faithfully,

A/Director of Criminal Investigation.

Col. Yuen Liang,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Shanghai Special District.

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
P.B. Chinese Section. October 30, 1929.

The Chinese Lai Yu Medicine Co.

Sir,
Reference to the attached we have interviewed
Mr Chao Yi Sung (蔡雨光), proprietor of the Chinese Lai
Yu Medicine Company, No. 109 Kiangsi Road who informed us that
the sale and advertisement of the " Safety Liquid Medicine for
Cure of Opium Addiction", product of his Company, has been
suspended pending receipt of permission for the sale of the
medicine from the Ministry of Labour and Commerce. Mr Chao
Yi Sung stated that the medicine had already been registered
under Trade Mark and that he was going to Nanking within
the next two days to submit samples for examination in order
to get the necessary permission for its sale.

A. C. (Pol)
（批：30:10:29）
（签名：C. D. I.）
（批：Ack: formally
31/10 Sea）

档案编号 D.606.
（刑事调查处）办公笔记
警务处中文股。1929年10月30日。

华雨制药公司

先生：
参照附件，我们已约谈江西路109号华雨制药公司业主赵义松（蔡雨光）先生。他告知我们，其公司生产的“安全戒烟药水”的销售和广告已暂停，以待从工商部获得销售该药品的许可。赵义松先生称，该药品已注册商标，他将在未来两天内前往南京提交样品以供检验，从而获得必要的销售许可。

A. C. (警)
（批注：29年10月30日）
（签名：C. D. I.）

Translation of a letter No.1890 from the Public Safety Bureau of the
Shanghai Special District.

October 25, 1929.

Commissioner of Police,
Municipal Police,
International Settlement.

Sir,

I was in receipt of an instruction No.2100 from the
District Government transmitting a despatch from the
Ministry of Labour & Commerce to the following effect:-

"A despatch was received from the Opium Suppression
Committee to the effect that the advertisement
published by the Chinese Lai Yu Medicine Co.
(中國雷雨製藥公司) in the Min Kuo Shih Pao contained
a sentence that "The Safety Liquid Medicine made
by one Char for the Cure of Opium Addiction with
ease" was approved of by and registered with the
Ministry of Labour & Commerce of the Nationalist
Government. The despatch continued that as all
medicines for the cure of opium addiction have
been prohibited from sale by that Committee pending
the publication of a simple set of regulations
governing the examination and the granting of special
permission for the sale of such drugs, the liquid
medicine as advertised by the Lai Yu Medicine Co.
should be no exception, and concluded with an
enquiry whether the said liquid medicine was truly
approved of by and registered with this Ministry.
Though the trade mark of the company was registered
with this Ministry, the medicine has never been
registered nor has it ever been tendered for

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
总监办公室。
（批注：上海公共租界工部局警务处
C. I. D. 606.
29年10月28日）

上海特别市公安局第1890号来函译文。

1929年10月25日。

致：
国际租界
警务处总监。

先生：

本人收到区政府转来的第2100号指令，其中传达了工商部的公函，内容如下：

“收到禁烟委员会公函，称华雨制药公司（中國雷雨製藥公司）在《民国日报》上刊登的广告中有一句‘查氏所制安全戒烟药水，轻松戒除烟瘾’，声称已获国民政府工商部批准并注册。公函续称，鉴于该委员会已禁止所有戒烟药品的销售，直至颁布一套简单的条例以规范此类药物的检验及特许销售许可的授予，华雨制药公司广告宣传的药水亦不应例外，并最后询问该药水是否确经本部批准并注册。虽然该公司的商标已在本部注册，但该药品从未注册，也从未提交供

page_data.en:
2

examination. The registration of a trade mark is merely
to protect the trade mark of the product of a firm against
infringement and has not the force of serving as a proof
as to the legitimacy of their products. The company in
applying trade mark registration to the registration of
their products has been guilty of fraud. Apart from
instructing the company to tender their liquid medicine
for analysis by the Opium Suppression Committee, we have to
request the District Government to order the company to
withdraw their advertisement and to stop the sale of the
medicine prior to permission being first obtained from the
Opium Suppression Committee."

As the company mentioned is situated in the San Ho Li,
Kiangse Road, International Settlement, I have, apart from
notifying them to withdraw their advertisement and stop the
sale of the medicine, to request you to instruct your subor-
dinates to take necessary suppressive steps in the matter.

Yuen Liang,
Chief of the Bureau.
page_data.zh:
2

检验。商标注册仅是为了保护公司产品商标免受侵权，并不具备作为其产品合法性证明的效力。该公司将商标注册应用于其产品注册，实属欺诈行为。除指令该公司向禁烟委员会提交其药水进行分析外，我们还要求区政府命令该公司撤回广告，并在首先获得禁烟委员会许可之前停止销售该药品。”

鉴于上述公司位于国际租界江西路三和里，除通知其撤回广告并停止销售该药品外，本人还请求阁下指令下属在此事上采取必要的取缔措施。

袁良，
局长。
